Student $i$ in room $\sigma(i)$ has displeasure $b_i \cdot L_{\sigma(i)}$.

Misery $M = \sum_i b_i \cdot L_{\sigma(i)} = \sum_j L_j^2$ (since $\sum_{i: \sigma(i)=j} b_i \cdot L_j = L_j \cdot L_j = L_j^2$).
